name: normal_boot_spare_test_done
purpose: Handle full spare-RAM result and start color-RAM test

name: normal_boot_spare_error_ack
purpose: Wait for acknowledgement after spare-RAM error and resume color test

name: normal_boot_color_test_done
purpose: Handle full color-RAM result and start playfield test

name: normal_boot_playfield_test_done
purpose: Handle full playfield-RAM result and start alpha test

name: normal_boot_alpha_test_done
purpose: Handle full alpha-RAM result and start MOB test

name: normal_boot_mob_test_done
purpose: Handle full MOB-RAM result and enter main initialization

name: selftest_spare_test_done
purpose: Handle short spare-RAM result and start color test

name: selftest_spare_error_ack
purpose: Resume short diagnostics after spare-RAM error display

name: selftest_color_test_done
purpose: Handle short color-RAM result and start playfield test

name: selftest_playfield_test_done
purpose: Handle short playfield-RAM result and start alpha test

name: selftest_alpha_test_done
purpose: Handle short alpha-RAM result and start MOB test

name: selftest_mob_test_done
purpose: Handle short MOB-RAM result and enter main initialization

name: boot_postcheck_dispatch
purpose: Finish hardware/EEPROM checks, clear work RAM, and dispatch OS or game

name: game_descriptor_ram_test
purpose: Run the short memory test for a game checksum-descriptor RAM range
exceptional_convention: saves complete register set and tail-enters tester with A4 continuation

name: game_descriptor_ram_test_done
purpose: Restore descriptor-test state and display a failing address
arguments: inherited D4.w=test status; A5=saved stack frame
exceptional_convention: A4 continuation; restores another entry's saved registers

name: game_rom_checksum_error
purpose: Identify and display a failed even/odd game-ROM checksum slice
arguments: D0.b/D1.b=checksum accumulators; A0=range end; inherited descriptor frame in A6

name: playfield_add_word_test_range
purpose: Add a word delta to 4,095 tested playfield words
arguments: delta in low word of one normal longword slot

name: color_test_palette_init
purpose: Install fixed six-word diagnostic color palette

name: selftest_load_control_labels
purpose: Copy game-specific or default control labels into OS work buffers

name: copy_cstring
purpose: Copy a NUL-terminated string including its terminator
